Provoda коротко звучит, когда что-то зак: Provoda plays a short sound when something finishes or fails. The volume is the one set for alert sounds. There are no sounds when interface sound effects are turned off in System Settings, Sound
Provoda смотрит, нет ли новой версии, пр: Provoda looks for a new version at launch, every three hours and after the Mac wakes up
Новая версия скачивается и ставится сама: A new version downloads and installs by itself when Provoda is idle. With this off, Provoda only offers to update
При варианте «Как в системе» Provoda бер: With “Same as System”, Provoda takes the first suitable language from the list in System Settings, Language & Region. A new language takes effect after a restart
Язык сменится после перезапуска: The language changes after a restart
При входе в систему Provoda запускается: At login Provoda starts in the menu bar, to install updates on time
Запуск при входе выключен в Системных на: Opening at login is turned off in System Settings, under Login Items. It can be turned back on only there
Сервер обновлений просит подождать: The update server asks to wait
Установщика новой версии пока нет: No installer for the new version yet
Новая версия подписана иначе: The new version is signed differently
Проверьте интернет и попробуйте ещё раз: Check the internet connection and try again
Слишком много проверок подряд. Попробуйт: Too many checks in a row. Try again in an hour
Новая версия вышла, но её установщик ещё: A new version is out, but its installer isn’t posted yet. Try again later
Скачивание не закончилось. Попробуйте ещ: The download didn’t finish. Try again or get the installer from the download page
Скачанный установщик повреждён или в нём: The downloaded installer is damaged or has no new version of Provoda in it. Try again
Новая версия подписана не так, как устан: The new version is signed differently from the installed one and won’t install by itself. Get the installer from the download page and drag Provoda to the Applications folder
Не получилось поставить новую версию. От: Couldn’t install the new version. Open the installer and drag Provoda to the Applications folder
Новая версия встанет, когда Provoda осво: The new version goes in when Provoda is idle or quits
Эта сборка сделана из исходного кода и с: This build is made from the source code and doesn’t update itself
Автоматическая проверка выключена. Прове: Automatic checks are off. Check with this button or with “Check for Updates…” in the menu of the menu bar icon
Provoda сам проверяет, вышла ли новая ве: Provoda checks for a new version by itself and installs it when it is idle
Provoda checks for a new version by itself and offers to install it
Устройства USB и Thunderbolt появятся зд: USB and Thunderbolt devices show up here as soon as you plug them in
Серийный номер появится под именем устро: The serial number appears under the device name, and you can select and copy it
Хабы внутри переходников и мониторов и с: Hubs inside adapters and displays, and the Mac's own devices. Whatever is plugged in through such a hub stays in the list
Когда появляется новое устройство, macOS: When a new device appears, macOS shows a notification with its name and speed
